podcast.body: This album was a futuristic conceptual work that accurately predicted the omnipresence of computing in daily life, anticipating digital communications after earlier albums explored terrestrial ones. It gained significant popularity in US ghettos and showcased Kraftwerk's continued leadership in electronic music, even as other electronic bands emerged. "En 1981 lanzaron Computer World, una obra conceptual futurista que predijo la omnipresencia de la informática en la vida cotidiana."
